feeds.title: The Plant Gallery Blog
feeds.description: The Plant Gallery is a comprehensive center for sophisticated lifestyle & gardening services and products. We specialize in custom landscaping and floral arrangements for events. Our blog features all the tips and advice to get your garden growing for everyone from beginners to experts.

feeds.title: Mirliton Blog
feeds.description: Mirliton.org is a nonprofit organization dedicated to promoting the conservation and innovative uses of Louisiana heirloom mirlitons. Dr. Lance Hill is the former founder and director of the Southern Institute for Education and Research at Tulane University and is an expert on the origins and cultivation of Louisiana heirloom mirlitons. Check out his articles on various plants, gardening tips, suggestions and more!

feeds.title: Country Roads » Gardening
feeds.description: Gardening in the humid South. Country Roads is a cultural print and online magazine focused on events, festivals, art, cuisine, and travel around South Louisiana and Mississippi - published continuously since 1983.

feeds.title: Grow Your Own Food Anywhere
feeds.description: We are all concerned with the quality and safety of our food today. You can grow on a back patio, on a windowsill, in a spare room, in your living room, on a balcony, in a greenhouse, just about anywhere that you can spare a little space. There are many space-saving methods and methods of growing that will increase your yield and your harvest. We intend to discuss all of these options on this blog.
